method.participantAndDescriptionHits: exact literal substring occurrence plus source offsets and hashes; no identity or semantic inference
method.exactStringNormalization: none; offsets are JavaScript UTF-16 source offsets into the frozen sourceRange text
method.extraDescriptionCheck: separate diagnostic normalizes each candidate description and whole frozen range with NFKC plus whitespace collapse; normalized results have no exact source offset and are not used for grounding
method.tableEvidenceRegions: table header context is derived from the frozen zone relationText prefix before anchorText; row body is frozen anchorText
method.lexicalCoverage: candidate description with literal participant strings removed; exact NFC 3-gram overlap (2-gram only for strings shorter than 3 code points), plus longest literal substring; diagnostic only, never semantic proof
method.nearMatches: Levenshtein distance on unnormalized source and candidate strings, emitted only within a length-based threshold; diagnostic only, never admitted as evidence
method.oldValidatorEquivalent: reproduces exact-chunk, same-zone participant literals plus complete exact relation description in the body region; table headers are not relation evidence
